meta.name: design-system-generator
meta.description: Create design systems with tokens, components, and documentation. Use when building design systems, creating component libraries, or establishing design tokens.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用设计令牌、组件和文档搭建完整设计系统
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要从零构建或维护一个统一的设计系统
copy.tagline_en: Build complete design systems with tokens, components, and documentation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to build or maintain a unified design system from scratch

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据你的品牌色和需求，自动生成设计系统的完整文件，包括颜色、字体、间距等设计令牌，以及按钮、输入框等基础组件和配套文档。
howto.when: 当你要求创建设计系统、组件库或建立设计令牌时触发。

say.text: 帮我生成一套以蓝色为主色调的设计系统。
say.note: Claude 会创建颜色、字体等令牌和基础组件。

say.text: 为我的组件库添加一个卡片组件。
say.note: Claude 会参考模板实现 Card 组件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate a complete design system based on your brand colors and needs, including design tokens (colors, typography, spacing) and base components (Button, Input, Card) with documentation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to create a design system, component library, or establish design tokens.

say_en.text: Generate a design system with blue as the primary color.
say_en.note: Claude will create tokens and base components.

say_en.text: Add a Card component to my component library.
say_en.note: Claude will implement Card following the reference.
